audit_label: R816 MM2 dungeon encounter grids audit
audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: THE MM2 DUNGEON ENCOUNTER TABLES WALK - the ten Monster Level grids (the tables that ride with the DMG Appendix C tables; the print pp. 133-134), every die row 2-20 pinned as the five-cell grid (die, source, number min, number max, special). THE SETTLED READS (the two 1st-edition word layers the voices, the merged index and the registry keys the cross-checks): the Bowler, Norker, Thoqqua (the index Rock worm), Nupperibo (an MM2 demon, the registry def source MM2 over the scan-A FF misread) and Grimlock (the scan-A word layer garbage, the scan-B clean 2-12) all settle against the index and registry; the scan-A Pseudowraith reads Pseudo-wraith (the scan-B hyphen), the MM2 pseudo-undead family def the walk key; the Daemon Mezzo- row (the scan-A Mono- the misread - the mezzodaemon is the FF daemon, monodaemon is not a print creature); the two word layers disagree on the Land Lamprey cell (scan A 2-8, scan B 2-6) - the scan-A read pins, flagged for the physical copy; the Chasme cell (scan A 1-2, scan B 1-3) settles 1-3, the registry def noAppearing 1-3 or 1-6 corroborating the scan-B read; the Green Slime number cell is dropped by BOTH word layers - the MM1 registry def noAppearing 1-6 the settle voice, flagged for the physical copy; the Level VI die 15/16 duplicate (the Troll row) settles 15 Troll by the scan-B column read; the character-party rows carry no source and no number (the DMG subtable reference); the four Level X unique rows (the demon prince, the elemental prince of evil, Charon and the devil duke) carry the court bullet instead of a number - the Orcus, Tiamat and Anthraxus court examples pinned as bools; the dragon age cells read Anc., Anc. O. and Anc. V.O. in both word layers (the Ancient spell-outs on Level VIII and X); the Daemon Charon rows walk the charonadaemon key (the lesser daemon, not the unique boatman); the table heads print MONSTER LEVEL I through X with the Level VII continuation heading (both scans the VII cont. reading, the scan-A word layer VI cont. the single-glyph loss).

banner.title: THE MM2 DUNGEON ENCOUNTER TABLES WALK - THE TEN MONSTER LEVEL GRIDS (pp. 133-134: the ten tables I through X, the 1d8+1d12 method, the character-party rows, and the unique-court rows of Level X), the DUNGEON-FLIP round - the Dungeon Random Encounter Tables gap box flips to closed
banner.provenance: Round twenty-one of the MM2 arc, the first table-group round (Curtiss Go call on the landed R815 WXYZ walk; the pin-time walk found ten printed grids of 19 die rows each, no defs promoted - the registry stays 809)
banner.sentinel: The pin header stays the print-fidelity record; the grids carry the die, source, number and special cells, the row rosters ride the audit comments, and the walk cross-checks the registry keys live
